November 28, 1940.

Intelligence Section of the Japanese Military Police -
dissolved.

The Intelligence Section of the Japanese
Military Police, 4 Yung Loh Tsung, Jessfield Road,
O.O.L., was dissolved on November 27, 1940 by order
of the Japanese authorities, ostensibly because it
lacked efficiency. Approximately thirty members
belonging this section have been paid off and it is
reported that the majority of the arms with which
they were issued have been returned to the Japanese
Military Police. The office is now the residence
of TING CHIEN QUAN (丁健权), a notorious
loafer in the Western District, who was in charge
of this section and he still retains the services
of four of its members as bodyguards.

This section, it will be remembered, came
into existence in September, 1939 under the auspices
Special
of the Service Corps of the Chung Kuo Kuomintang
Anti Comintern and National Salvation Army (now
known as the Shanghai Office of the Ministry of
Police), 76 Jessfield Road, and was later placed
under the direct control of the Japanese Military
Police, 94 Jessfield Road, O.O.L., sometime during
November, 1939. As was previously reported, members
of this section were believed to be concerned in the
attempt on the life of Mr. G. Godfrey Phillips,
Secretary and Commissioner General of the Shanghai
Municipal Council, which took place on Avenue Haig,
on January 6, 1940.

1940年11月28日。

日本宪兵队情报科 - 已解散。

位于极司菲尔路（Jessfield Road）永禄宗4号、越界筑路区（O.O.L.）的日本宪兵队情报科，奉日本当局命令于1940年11月27日解散，表面原因为效率低下。该科约三十名成员已被遣散并结清薪资，据报他们配发的大部分武器已交还日本宪兵队。该办事处现为丁健权（TING CHIEN QUAN）的住所，此人是西区 notorious loafer（注：此处loafer通常指无业游民或流氓），曾负责该科工作，他仍留用其中四名成员作为保镖。

需指出的是，该科成立于1939年9月，在中国国民党反共救国军特别工作团（现称警察部上海办事处，地址为极司菲尔路76号）的主持下成立，后于1939年11月间某时置于极司菲尔路94号、越界筑路区（O.O.L.）的日本宪兵队直接控制之下。如前所报，该科成员被认为涉嫌参与1940年1月6日在海格路（Avenue Haig）发生的针对上海公共租界工部局秘书长兼总办 G. Godfrey Phillips 先生的暗杀未遂事件。

notorious loafer in the Western District, who was

This section, it will be remembered, came

on Avenue Haig, on January 3, 1940.

位于极司菲尔路（Jessfield Road）永禄宗4号、中心越界筑路区（C.O.L.）的日本宪兵队情报科，奉日本当局命令于1940年11月27日解散，表面原因为效率低下。该科约三十名成员已被遣散并结清薪资，据报他们配发的大部分武器已交还日本宪兵队。该办事处现为丁健坤（TING CHIEN QUAN）的住所，此人是西区 notorious loafer（注：此处loafer通常指无业游民或流氓），曾负责该科工作，他仍留用其中四名成员作为保镖。

需指出的是，该科成立于1939年9月，在中国国民党反共救国军特别工作团（现称警察部上海办事处，地址为极司菲尔路76号）的主持下成立，后于1939年11月间某时置于极司菲尔路94号、中心越界筑路区（C.O.L.）的日本宪兵队直接控制之下。如前所报，该科成员被认为涉嫌参与1940年1月3日在海格路（Avenue Haig）发生的针对上海公共租界工部局秘书长兼总办 G. Godfrey PHILLIPS 先生的暗杀未遂事件。

FILE

The branch office of the Intelligence
Section of the Japanese Military Police located
at House 5, Saung Yue Li (双餘里), Nan Zao
Ka Zah, off Edinburgh Road, O.O.I., was closed on
July 20, by the Japanese Military Police. This
action is reported to have been taken in consequence
of the fact that complaints have been received
from residents in the vicinity against the members
of the branch who have been extorting money and
carrying out other illegal activities.

During the night of July 19, at about 10 p.m.
a party of members attached to the Intelligence
Section of the Japanese Military Police in charge
of TING CHIEN KWEN (丁建坤) raided the branch
office, but the person in charge of the branch
and his subordinates are said to have absconded
before the visit, taking six mauser pistols with
them.

This branch came into existence on May 19,
1940 and was in charge of one WOC MING FAH
(胡明發), a loafer in the Western District.
It consisted of twelve plain-clothes men armed with
six Mauser pistols.

C. Crawford
D. I.

位于爱丁堡路（Edinburgh Road）旁、南赵家宅（Nan Zao Ka Zah）双餘里（Saung Yue Li）5号的日本宪兵队情报科分所，于7月20日被日本宪兵队关闭。据报采取此行动的原因是，附近居民投诉该分所成员勒索钱财并进行其他非法活动。

7月19日晚约10点，一队隶属于日本宪兵队情报科、由丁建坤（TING CHIEN KWEN）率领的成员突袭了该分所，但据称该分所负责人及其下属在突袭前已潜逃，并带走了六支毛瑟手枪。

Bubbling Well Station Daily Report
dated June 11, 1940.

Hire Car commandeered by armed men.

At 11.15 p.m. June 9, 1940, a chauffeur employed
by the Sing Hai Garage, 888 Rue Amiral Bayle, F.C.,
whilst passing the Paradise Ballroom, Yu Ya Ching Road,
was hailed by a door boy to convey a male Chinese
to the Wusih Lodging House off Brenan Road, S.C.G. Territory.
On arriving at the place the chauffeur was asked to
proceed to Room No.7 to assist in removing a radio. In the
mentioned room there were already other two male Chinese
and shortly afterwards a fourth man entered and then one
of the two men drew a pistol and intimidated the
chauffeur. The Chinese who had hired the car then left
the room. At about 4 a.m. June 10 another man left the
room and returned at 7 a.m. stating that they had "failed".
The driver was then given $10.00 and told that his car was
at Kiaochow Road North of Avenue Road.

For further particulars, see Misc. Report 404/40 (BW).

Made by and Forwarded by D. I. Crawford.

The offices of the Intelligence Section of the
Japanese Military Police have been removed from 25-26-27
Sing Kyi Tsung, Jessfield Road, to House 18 of the same
alleyway. The premises vacated were converted and
operates now as the "Wusih Lodging House" (無錫旅館)
which formally opened on June 5. Discreet enquiries
reveal that this lodging house serves as a rendezvous
for members and agents of the Intelligence Section as
well as Japanese.

On June 6, members of the Intelligence Section
commenced the collection of money, ranging from $10.00
to $30.00 from shops and factories situated in the
Western District, O.O.L. because of the approach of the
Dragon Boat Festival which falls on June 10. A number
of concerns are reported to have paid this contribution
under threats.

The section is in charge of TING CHIEN QUAN
(丁建坤), a notorious loafer in the Western District,
O.O.L.

C. Crawford

the Western District, and he has twelve plain-clothes
members who are in possession of six Mauser pistols.
He was recommended to this post by TING CHIEN KWEN
(丁健坤), chief of the Intelligence Section,
who is also a well-known loafer in the Western
District.

The Intelligence Section of the Japanese
Military Police was formed in September, 1939 under
the auspices of the Special Service Corps of the
Chung Kuo Kuomintang Anti-Comintern and National
Salvation Army, and was later placed under the
direct control of the Japanese Military Police, 94
Jessfield Road, O.O.L. during November, 1939.

It is to be noted that information was obtained that
it was members of this section who took part in the
attempted assassination of Mr. G. Godfrey PHILLIPS,
Secretary and Commissioner General of S.M.C., on
January 6, 1940.

C. Crawford
D. I.
D.C. (Special Branch).

January 29, 1940.
Intelligence Section of the Japanese Military Police
at Yung Loh Tsung Jessfield Road, O.O.L. - Removal
----------------

The Intelligence Section of the Japanese
Military Police at 12 Yung Loh Tsung, Jessfield,
O.C.L., the members of which were believed to be
involved in the attempt on the life of Mr. G. Godfrey
Phillips on Avenue Haig on January 6, 1940, removed
on January 28 to Nos. 25-26-27, Sing Nyi Tsung
(信義邨), Jessfield Road, O.O.L.

This section was formed in September 1939
under the auspices of the Special Service Corps of
the Chung Kuo Kuomintang Anti-Comintern and
National Salvation Army, but in November the same
year, was placed under the direct control of the
Western District Section of the Japanese Military
Police, 94 Jessfield Road, O.O.L.

It is in charge of Ting Chien Kwen (丁建坤),
a well-known loafer in the Western District.

1940年1月29日。
日本宪兵队情报科位于越界筑路区极司菲尔路永隆邨（Yung Loh Tsung）——搬迁
---

位于越界筑路区极司菲尔路永隆邨12号的日本宪兵队情报科，其成员被认为参与了1940年1月6日在海格路（Avenue Haig）企图杀害 G. Godfrey Phillips 先生的行动，该科于1月28日搬迁至越界筑路区极司菲尔路信义邨（Sing Nyi Tsung）25-26-27号。

该科于1939年9月在中国国民党反共救国军特别服务团的庇护下成立，但在同年11月，被置于越界筑路区极司菲尔路94号日本宪兵队西区分部的直接控制之下。

该科由丁建坤（Ting Chien Kwen）负责，此人是西区一带知名的游手好闲之徒。

REPORT
File No. S. B. D. 8373
Date December 21, 39.

Subject Shooting in no. 12 fung Loh Tsung (永隆邨), Jessfield road,
U.C.L..
Made by J.S.I. Liao Chung Chien Forwarded by J.I. Crawford

〔左侧手写批注：〕
Kwala 1/20
DOB
E

〔左侧方框内文字及签名：〕
Comm...
Sir:
Jho Roberts
(S. R.)

〔左侧印章及手写：〕
Sa CG
B.M.
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COMMISSIONER 23 DEC. 1939）

〔左下角手写：〕
C 9/12.

At 9.50 a.m. December 20, 1939, shots were fired
in house 12, fung Loh Tsung (永隆邨), Jessfield road,
U.C.L., occupied by an intelligence office of the
Western District Section of the Japanese Military
Police, 94 Jessfield Road. A man was wounded and
was subsequently removed to the Foo Ling Hospital,
North Szechuen Road, for treatment.

Discreet enquiries show that the wounded man is
one named Lu Dah Pang (吕大鹏), a member of the
intelligence office, and was shot at by Ting Chien
Wen (丁建坤), chief of the office. It is
reported that two of the followers of Lu Dah Pang
carried out an armed robbery at 15 Fung Loh Tsung,
Jessfield Road, on December 19 and obtained a total
sum of $1,400.00. A dispute between the persons
taking part in the crime over the disbursement of the
loot resulted in the case being brought to the notice
of Ting Chien Wen who without hesitation summoned
Lu Dah Pang to the office on the morning of December
20, 1939 and demanded a statement from him. The
latter denied being implicated and charged Ting with
malicious accusation with the result that Ting took
out his pistol and fired three shots at Lu Dah Pang.

Liao Chung Chien.
J. S. I.
D.C. (Special Branch).

主题：越界筑路区（U.C.L.）极司菲尔路永隆邨（fung Loh Tsung）12号发生的枪击事件。
由特别情报科督察廖仲坚（Liao Chung Chien）撰写，由 J.I. Crawford 呈报

〔左侧手写批注：〕
Kwala 1/20
DOB
E

〔左侧方框内文字及签名：〕
Comm...

Jho Roberts
(S. R.)

Sa CG
B.M.
（印：上海公共租界工部局总办 1939年12月23日）

〔左下角手写：〕
C 9/12.

1939年12月20日上午9时50分，在越界筑路区（U.C.L.）极司菲尔路永隆邨（fung Loh Tsung）12号发生枪击事件，该处由位于极司菲尔路94号的日本宪兵队西区分部的情报办公室占用。一人受伤，随后被送往北四川路福林医院（Foo Ling Hospital）接受治疗。

经 discreet enquiries（审慎调查）显示，伤者名为吕大鹏（Lu Dah Pang），系该情报办公室成员，遭办公室主任丁建坤（Ting Chien Wen）开枪射击。据报道，吕大鹏的两名手下于12月19日在极司菲尔路永隆邨15号实施武装抢劫，共得赃款1,400.00元。参与犯罪的人员因分赃不均发生争执，此事引起丁建坤注意，丁于1939年12月20日上午毫不犹豫地将吕大鹏召至办公室，要求其作出说明。吕否认涉案，并指控丁恶意诬陷，结果丁拔出手枪向吕大鹏连开三枪。

廖仲坚
特别情报科督察
副总监（特别情报科）。
